```{r}
#| label: vas-ancova-unadjusted
#| include: false

vas_var <- c("vas_tb1_beh", "vas_tb2_lang", "vas_tb3_eat")
vas_label <- c(
  "Severity of Behavior Problems (cm)",
  "Severity of Language Abilities (cm)",
  "Severity of Eating Behavior (cm)"
)

names(vas_label) = vas_var

# fit ANCOVA models (unadjusted for demographics)
vas_ancova_unadj <- lapply(
  vas_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova(
    dataset = data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = vas_label[x],
    demo_vars = NULL,
    covariates = NULL
  )
)
names(vas_ancova_unadj) <- vas_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova output
vas_ancova_unadj_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(vas_ancova_unadj),
    function(x) {
      vas_ancova_unadj[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)

# Note: Plots will be added in a future iteration
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-vas-ancova-unadjusted
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "VAS - Unadjusted ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline and 16-week change,
#|    and between-group difference in changes (not adjusted for demographics). {data_caption}")

vas_ancova_unadj_ft <- vas_ancova_unadj_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-contrast_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences"),
    colwidths = c(1, 7, 7, 4)
  ) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 8, 15), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

vas_ancova_unadj_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-vas-ancova-unadjusted-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "VAS - Forest plot showing unadjusted between-group differences in changes. {data_caption}")

plot_ancova_forest(
  obj = vas_ancova_unadj,
  labels = vas_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1
)
```
